description: Which kinds of act a part of a delegation asks for. Eight independent Nouls, one per kind of act, each with its own line. Until every line is set by calibration, a provisional Choice reads one kind and the record says it is provisional. The kinds and their tests have one home, the subagent-ledger skill's scripts/kinds.json; this file names them and never restates a test.
question: Which kinds of act does this part ask for?
basis: No line is measured. Version 0 reads one kind with the provisional Choice. The Nouls are defined so calibration can set their lines; they are not asked at dispatch until it does.
subject: the part: what it asks for, as the plan states it, with the brief's task text where the brief is written

nouls.instructions_template: This is one part of a piece of delegated work, given as `part`: what the part asks a subagent to do, and its inputs. Judge the work the part asks to be done, not the work around it or the reason it is asked. {test}

provisional_reading.used_while: any line in nouls.lines is null
provisional_reading.instructions: This is one part of a piece of delegated work, given as `part`: what the part asks a subagent to do, and its inputs. Which one kind of act does the part ask for? Judge the work the part asks to be done, not the work around it. Choose `none` when no kind's test is met, or when the part asks for two kinds equally.
provisional_reading.criteria_from: each kind's test, keyed by its name

none.label: none
none.criterion: The part meets no kind's test, or it asks for two or more kinds of act and no one of them is the part's purpose.

line_rule: A Noul is over its line when its probability of yes is at or above the line.

outcomes.when: no Noul is over its line; or, while provisional, the Choice reads none
outcomes.route: the part goes back to the parent as a finding; no persona is chosen for it

outcomes.when: exactly one Noul is over its line; or, while provisional, the Choice reads one kind
outcomes.route: the part goes on with that kind
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, by invoking the skill

outcomes.when: two or more Nouls are over their lines
outcomes.route: the part is split into one part per kind, each with its own record
outcomes.delegated_authority: the parent, by invoking the skill

outcomes.when: user-decision is among the kinds read
outcomes.answer: user-decision, with any other kind read
outcomes.route: raised with the parent, who asks the user before the call goes out

outcomes.when: the request fails or times out
outcomes.route: the part goes back to the parent; the dispatch is not stopped

calibration.measure: per-kind recall against false marks on the held-out half; confusions between kinds that lead to different groups
calibration.minimum_held_out: 10 briefs for each kind the set claims to test
